title: Malacañang: No additional Uplift funds due to oil price risks

blocks.text: MANILA – Malacañang on Tuesday said the government won’t automatically allocate additional funds for the expanded Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport (Uplift) program due to projected higher oil prices, with any funding increase to depend on the actual needs and requests of implementing agencies.
